title: VWP-Bench scoring rubric
description: A published scoring rubric (VWP-Bench proposal, Aug 2026): named areas that add up to the total score, each scored as yes/no items (full or zero credit), a proportional count (captured / total), or a 0–5 rating times a multiplier; plus the cap conditions that hold the signability rating at capMaxRating or below regardless of total. The rubric, weights, answer key, and tie-breaking rules are fixed before the models see the case. benchmark/rubric/vwp-bench-rubric.v1.json is the reference instance.

capConditions.description: Conditions a grader may flag; any flagged condition caps the rating in capAreaKeys at capMaxRating.

capMaxRating.description: Highest rating a capped work product may receive (proposal: 'cannot receive a 4 or 5').

capAreaKeys.description: rating-kind areas the cap applies to.

points.description: Maximum points for the area. yesNoItems: must equal the sum of item points; rating: must equal 5 × ratingMultiplier.

items.description: yesNoItems only — full or zero credit per item.

countSource.description: proportional only — what is counted (e.g. required facts in the private case key, correctly stated and supported).

preWorkTests.description: Machine tests (VWP-TT battery codes) whose verdicts inform the grader for this area. Pre-work only — never scores an item.
